description.value: Langara Island Lodge is a remote, fly-in all-inclusive luxury fishing resort on the northern tip of Haida Gwaii, reachable only by charter flight from Vancouver to Masset followed by a 15-minute helicopter transfer to the island. The lodge is widely regarded as one of BC's premier saltwater salmon fishing destinations, operating 17 fully equipped 25-foot guide boats with professional staff and offering packages for couples, families, and corporate groups. Three accommodation options — Chinook Lodge, Eagle Lodge, and Raven Cottage — provide guests with what the lodge describes as relaxed luxury in a strikingly isolated Pacific setting.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Langara Island Lodge is an operational all-inclusive fly-in fishing resort on Langara Island, Haida Gwaii, accepting 2026 reservations; guests arrive by charter flight from Vancouver to Masset then a 15-minute helicopter transfer to the lodge — there is no road, ferry, or cyclable route to this location. The contact page provides a toll-free number (1-877-999-3503) and email (info@langaraislandlodge.com) not present in OSM tags. No cycling-related amenities (bike storage, laundry, tools, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site, and the all-inclusive package focuses entirely on fishing, meals, and guided boat trips.
